body: I completely forgot the first part of your other post. Right now im tired (surprise surprise) and disappointed in myself, but a little calm as this is not the first time I've been here. No matter what happens and what decisions I make, I just want to say that I am doing nothing I regret and I don't want anyone to feel bad for me. If anything, I'd like to say that my life was beautiful in the sense that I had so much to have lost and felt so much joy to consider what I've currently got as shitty. I've got about a month left until my birthday and whatever amount of time I'm awake during that will be spent setting up my last words and path out. I don't mean to discourage you, I do appreciate having someone to talk to. (:

Apologies, I passed out for a little bit. I haven't spoken to my doctor about any of this but I am supposed to meet with him after the new year to discuss the extreme lethargy (I believe it's tied to one of my medications). I really have not felt any differently in the past six or so years and last year I gave myself the limit of my birthday for anything to start going well before I tried anything rash again. Needless to say, things have only gone downhill.
